arguments.claim: Revenue rose 12% in 2025 [report], and the chair said "we will open two new sites in 2026" [report]. 81% of staff would recommend Example Co. [survey].

sources.text: Example Co. annual report, 2025. Revenue rose 12% to 4.2 million euros. The chair said: “we will open two new sites in 2026”.
Example Co. staff survey, March 2026. 81% of staff said they would recommend Example Co. as a place to work.
